market.rule: Continuous dry market loop with genuinely glazed wet/dry separation at the overlooking edge. Recess orange shop/market bays, canopy/soffit changes, planted seating outside walking strips. The loop must remain usable when pool access gates are closed.
market.retail_relationship: Preserve all 100 source shop allocations and original source order. Fore-port neighbour indices are 0,1,2,25,26,27 in the filtered historical shop list; they are not stable room IDs. Nearest are X−78..−66 and X−106..−94, Z−398..−386. Reserve west/aft future frontage connections outside their envelopes; do not relocate those shops into this market or invent a new business.
market.loop_fit_note: Front cross-connection moved1.5m away from closed stair-door cassette planeZ-428; dry bypass remainsX-10.85..-8.45.

ramp.status: Source-authored ramp and guards; runtime controller, loaded-cart comfort and species acceptance pending
rules: Keep guard and handrail projections outside the stated clear bands; provide edge protection and drained dry landings.
Raised deck excludes the entire ramp envelope and dry eastern approach. The upper landing must not cover a lower walking path.
Show slope, bottom and both return landings from ordinary arrival; do not hide the accessible entrance.

wet_market_link.status: Source-authored 6.3m CIR001 stair derivative and fitted two-stop enclosure; existing-controller integration pending
wet_market_link.rejected_three_stop_solution: Same-face 44/46.2/52.5 m stops overlap existing 2.65 m gate clear apertures and ~2.85 m frames; do not reuse that plan.

stair.rule: Existing stair family with a new 6.3 m authored derivative. 18 risers per flight; reserve at least 9.44 m including two landings. Do not assume the 6 m derivative reaches 52.5.

lift.rule: Positive 6.3 m stop separation. Recompute translated sills/cabin front clearances from the actual family; root placement is a proposal, not instantiated identity.

wet_market_link.rule: Join stair/lift voids to the main opening; no 0.5 m or 1.1 m leftover ledges pretending to be circulation. Authored lift enclosure occupies its part of the connected void.

environmental_boundary.status: Full-height glazed source boundary, sealed headers/cassette edges, real retained doorway fitting previews; runtime door instances pending
environmental_boundary.rule: Keep the upper stair/lift arrival within a wet-side enclosure with a dry-market threshold. Preserve the separate 2.4 m market bypass with these access doors closed. Full-height glass, header/ceiling seals and gate/pocket swept volumes must be drawn in the source before adoption.

staff.status: Upper source shaft/cap and enclosed service routes authored in AST-STF-009 derivative; preserve lower identities, pending runtime integration
rules: No new D04–D07 stops, gates or side branches. Blank enclosed shaft passes through these levels; prove actual mesh clearance through the whole sweep.
Retain all three lower gate/sill locations and persistent identities; rebuild source cap/upper shaft in a derivative, never hide a surviving cap with a new shaft.
Upper D08 stop is at wet Y46.2, explicitly not canonical arrival Y44. Staff do not push loaded carts up the public ramp to reach wet care.

Place dry supplies/dirty towel return in separate recessed niches outside the 2.4 m dogleg/cart turn envelope. Prove screening with doors open from both wet floor and market gallery; the plan does not yet certify it.
staff.adopted_screen_reason: Original planning screen did not block all open-aperture corner rays. New bounded baffle passes1444 source rays; retained532 changing-position/heading cart/operator proxy poses are in QA, not force-driven acceptance.

limitations: AABB plan only, not source triangle or runtime acceptance
Display stock uses source main_display_left_patch; actual triangle clearance remains untested
No new collisions, floors, controllers, catalogue IDs or business identities
